features.name: A turn from send to finish
features.what: A sent prompt lands as a bubble, shows a working line, streams the answer with the frog's typing bubble, and settles into a finished turn.

flows.name: see my prompt land in the transcript
steps: Type a prompt in the composer
flows.expected: The prompt springs up from the composer as a right-aligned bubble (a fade under Reduce Motion) and a turn begins below it.

flows.name: know frog started working before anything streams
steps: Wait before the first event arrives
flows.expected: A spinner with Working… (or the engine's progress words) shows under the prompt until the first item arrives; it never shows once the engine has exited.

flows.name: see a local model getting ready instead of a spinner
steps: Pick a local model that is not in memory (hand-off: models agent)
flows.expected: A loading card says the model is loading into memory with elapsed time and a bar, then gives way to the answer when the first response streams.

flows.name: read the answer as it is written
steps: Watch the answer while the engine streams text deltas
flows.expected: Words appear in the typing bubble as each delta arrives, not only when the message completes.

flows.name: see slow streams ink in and fast streams appear at once
steps: Send a prompt to a slow model
Send one to a fast model
Watch the text appear as it arrives
flows.expected: A slow stream reveals a few characters a frame with a capped fade; a fast stream or Reduce Motion skips the ink.

flows.name: see what frog is doing between steps
steps: Send a prompt that makes tool calls
Watch the turn's last line while a step runs
flows.expected: The tail says the step in words (Reading X…, Running the tests…, with elapsed seconds), or Thinking… between steps; it hides while text streams or a card is up.

flows.name: follow the agent's plan while it works
steps: Send a task that makes frog use TodoWrite
Watch the plan card in the running turn
flows.expected: A plan card lists each todo with pending, in-progress (tinted) and completed (struck through) marks while the turn runs, and goes when it ends.

flows.name: see the turn finish cleanly
flows.expected: The typing bubble fades into a plain message row, the spinner goes, the footer appears and the frog looks pleased; the conversation is no longer busy.

flows.name: see what happens when the model says nothing
steps: Send a prompt to a model that returns an empty reply twice
Wait for the turn to end
flows.expected: frog asks once more; a second empty reply ends the turn with a line saying so instead of silence.
flows.why_hard: Needs the real engine retry path or a scripted provider that returns empty replies.

flows.name: run a shell command straight from the composer
flows.expected: A Shell row runs the command without a model turn and shows its output; the conversation is busy until it finishes.

flows.name: use a memory command and get its answer
flows.expected: No model turn runs; the engine's answer arrives as a notice row.

flows.name: read context that was sent with my message
steps: Send a message that carries context (an issue or PR)
Click the › context chip under the bubble
flows.expected: The chip opens to the exact text the model was given and folds back.

flows.name: see images I attached in my bubble
steps: Attach an image in the composer (hand-off: composer agent)
flows.expected: Thumbnails show above the bubble and open in the lightbox.

features.name: Following the end and the new-below pill
features.what: The transcript keeps to the bottom while an answer streams, stops at a long answer's start, and offers a pill back down when something new arrives out of view.
entry_points: The pill at the bottom (Go to the end and follow the answer)

flows.name: open a conversation at its newest turn
steps: Pick a session with a long history in the sidebar
Look at where the transcript is scrolled
flows.expected: The transcript opens scrolled to the end with only on-screen rows built.

flows.name: keep reading a short answer as it streams
steps: Stay at the end of the transcript
flows.expected: The view stays pinned to the end as the answer grows, including a one-line answer (0.7.0, #408).

flows.name: start reading a long answer from its top
steps: Send a prompt that produces a long answer
Watch the view as the answer passes a screenful
flows.expected: Following stops with the answer's first line at the top instead of scrolling past it.
flows.why_hard: The existing test skips on CI until a post-park hang is found (commit b440055d); timing-sensitive.

flows.name: get back down after scrolling up mid-answer
flows.expected: A pill appears only once something new arrives below where you stopped; clicking it scrolls to the end and resumes following.

flows.name: scroll back through a long history
flows.expected: Older turns fill in above without moving the row you are reading; a loading line shows while older history is still being read.

flows.name: resize the window while reading
steps: Resize the window or split a pane
flows.expected: Visible rows relay out at the new width without gaps or overlaps, even while streaming.

features.name: Thinking rows
features.what: The model's reasoning shows as a quiet Thinking… line with a live subtitle that settles into Thought and opens to the full trace, depending on detail level.

flows.name: see what the model is thinking right now
flows.expected: A breathing dot and Thinking… with the sentence being written as a one-line subtitle.

flows.name: read a finished thought in full
steps: Click Show all if it is capped
flows.expected: The row reads Thought with its first line; it opens to the capped thought, Show all reveals the rest, and it folds back.

flows.name: not see noise from trivial thoughts
steps: Send a prompt whose thoughts are very short
flows.expected: A short thought alone is left out; one between steps is its own line.

features.name: Tool-call rows and activity folds
features.what: What frog did shows as muted activity lines (Read 3 files, ran the tests) that open to each step, each step opening to its diff, output or report.
entry_points: Hover a step for the raw command

flows.name: see a one-line summary of what was done
steps: Send a task that reads, edits and runs commands
flows.expected: Consecutive steps fold into one sentence like Edited 2 files +18 −6, ran the tests; failures are counted; running steps are not in the sentence yet.

flows.name: see each step behind a summary
flows.expected: The line opens to one row per step (Read PaneView.swift, Ran xcodebuild test · passed) and folds back; a lone step opens straight to its content.

flows.name: read a short result without clicking
steps: Let frog run a tool whose result is a sentence (SendMessage, a short display)
flows.expected: The result shows on the row's own line and the row has no chevron when nothing more is hidden.

flows.name: see the diff of an edit
steps: Click N more lines on a long diff
flows.expected: The row says the file with +added −removed and opens to a highlighted diff with old/new line numbers, collapsed past a cut with N more lines.

flows.name: check a command and its output
steps: Let frog run a shell command
flows.expected: The command shows with worktree paths elided, its ANSI-styled output below, folded past 24 lines.

flows.name: read a plain-words gist of a command
steps: Let frog run a long shell command
Wait for the side model's gist
flows.expected: The row's words switch from the raw argument to the gist; the hover help still carries the raw command.

flows.name: watch a running command's output
steps: Let frog run a long command
Watch its row while it runs
flows.expected: A live tail of the output (or a progress bar with a message for tools that report progress) shows under the running row with a streaming marker.

flows.name: spot steps that failed or were denied
flows.expected: A failed step is tagged with a short error word in red, a denied one says Denied, a skipped one Skipped.

flows.name: read a finished subagent's report
flows.expected: The report reads like an answer (markdown) under the row.

features.name: Inline visuals: diagrams, Visualize widgets, Present cards, images, MCP apps
features.what: Diagrams, interactive widgets, Present tables/charts/actions, generated images and MCP App UIs render inline as part of the answer, with their own controls.
entry_points: Diagram card buttons (Source, Export, Open in its own window, expand)

flows.name: see a diagram appear in the answer
steps: Ask frog to draw a diagram
flows.expected: A Drawing… line while the Diagram tool runs, then the diagram at the column width at no less than the readable scale.

flows.name: see a too-wide diagram in full
steps: Get a diagram wider than the column
flows.expected: The cropped diagram offers expand; expanded it draws the full layout, and collapses back to the compact view.

flows.name: read a diagram's source
flows.expected: The card flips to its Mermaid source in a code block and back.

flows.name: export a diagram
steps: Open the diagram's Export menu (or right-click it)
Pick Copy Image, Copy Mermaid, or Save as PNG/SVG/Mermaid
flows.expected: The image or Mermaid lands on the clipboard, or a save panel writes the file.
flows.why_hard: Save panels are modal system UI; clipboard variants are automatable.

flows.name: open a diagram in its own window and zoom
steps: Click Open in its own window on a diagram
Use Zoom In (⌘=), Zoom Out (⌘-), Actual Size (⌘0)
flows.expected: A diagram window opens with zoom controls and an Export menu.
flows.why_hard: Opens a separate SwiftUI window scene.

flows.name: jump from a diagram node to its file
steps: Open a code map or diagram with file-backed nodes
flows.expected: The node's help names the file and clicking opens it.
flows.why_hard: Opens a file in an external editor.

flows.name: map the project's structure
flows.expected: A diagram window opens with the code map, or a warning toast says the folder could not be mapped.
flows.why_hard: Runs a code-map scan of a real folder and opens a window.

flows.name: see an interactive visual frog made
steps: See the widget draw at its reported height
flows.expected: The widget runs in the locked-down web view, reports its height and draws; titles read as words.

flows.name: look closer at a widget
flows.expected: Expand shows the visual large; Done closes it; Source flips to the code and back.

flows.name: answer frog by pressing a Present action
steps: Get a Present card with action buttons
flows.expected: The pressed action becomes your next message (queued if a turn runs) and the other buttons go quiet.

flows.name: read a Present table, comparison, steps or chart
steps: Get a Present result with a table, chart or steps
flows.expected: The blocks draw natively as tables, side-by-side comparisons, steps, callouts and charts.

flows.name: look at a generated image full size
flows.expected: The lightbox opens on the clicked image, steps between them, zooms, and closes with Esc or the close button.

flows.name: copy, save or open an image
steps: Open an image in the lightbox
Pick Copy Image, Save…, or Open in Preview
flows.expected: The image is copied, saved through a panel, or opened in Preview.
flows.why_hard: Context menus, save panels and opening Preview.app are outside the app's views.

flows.name: use an MCP App's own UI in the answer
steps: Call an MCP tool that ships an app
Let it call a tool on its server
flows.expected: Only the latest call's app shows; the app's tool calls go to the engine and their results come back to the app.
flows.why_hard: Needs an MCP server with a UI resource and the web view bridge.

features.name: Code blocks, links and copy
features.what: Answers render markdown with code blocks, tables and links; text is selectable; prompts and answers can be copied.
entry_points: Code block Copy button / right-click Copy, Save As…
Hover a finished turn's footer (Copy answer)

flows.name: read a formatted answer
steps: Get an answer with headings, lists, quotes, tables and code
flows.expected: Each block kind renders; a code block reserves its height so text after it sits below.

flows.name: copy a code block
flows.expected: Exactly the block's code is on the clipboard.

flows.name: save a code block to a file
flows.expected: A save panel writes the code to a file.
flows.why_hard: Save panel is modal system UI.

flows.name: copy a passage that spans a code block
steps: Drag-select text across a code block
flows.expected: The copied text includes the code itself, not an attachment character; the block tints while selected.

flows.name: open a link in an answer
steps: Get an answer with a link
flows.expected: The link is in the accent colour with a pointing hand and opens in the default browser.
flows.why_hard: Opening the default browser leaves the app; would need a stubbed URL opener.

flows.name: copy what I asked
flows.expected: The prompt text is on the clipboard; the hover row also shows when it was sent.

flows.name: copy frog's answer
steps: Click Copy answer at the footer's end
flows.expected: All the turn's message text, joined, is on the clipboard.

flows.name: act on a file path frog mentions
steps: Right-click a file chip or changed-file row
Pick Open in editor, Reveal in Finder, Quick Look, Copy Path or Copy Relative Path
flows.expected: The file opens, is revealed, previews, or its path is copied.
flows.why_hard: Context menus, Finder and Quick Look are system UI.

features.name: Turn footer, stats and end banners
features.what: Under each finished turn a caption names the model, who served it, and its cost or tokens per second (and energy), each opening to its working; turns that stopped early show a banner instead.
entry_points: Click the price or energy hint

flows.name: see which model answered and how fast
steps: Finish a turn on a local model
flows.expected: The caption names the model with its place icon and the speed in tokens per second; hover shows calls and token counts.

flows.name: see that Frog Cloud served a turn whoever proxied it
steps: Finish a turn on a Frog Cloud model served by a third party
flows.expected: The footer says Frog Cloud in cloud green and draws identically to a first-party turn.

flows.name: see what a turn cost
steps: Finish a turn on a priced model
flows.expected: A card breaks the cost into parts (input, cached, output) with a split bar, in dollars per token.

flows.name: see a turn's energy use
steps: Turn on energy display (hand-off: settings agent)
flows.expected: An energy card shows the turn's energy and links to the history.

flows.name: keep finished turns uncluttered
flows.expected: On the Mac no footer is pinned: each fades in on hover (with Copy answer) without shifting text, and fades out again.

flows.name: understand why a turn stopped early
steps: Have a turn end by step limit, looping, output-token limit, or a retried denial
flows.expected: A banner says why (Stopped at the step limit. Say continue…, Hit the output token limit, …) in orange instead of the footer.

flows.name: fix running out of Frog Cloud credit
steps: Run a Frog Cloud turn with no credit
flows.expected: A muted out of credit line with an add credit link to the billing page (hand-off: account agent).

features.name: Errors, retries and notices
features.what: A failed turn shows a plain-words error with raw details folded away; retry and stand-in notices, warnings and a dead engine each say what happened.

flows.name: understand a model error
steps: Have the provider return an error
flows.expected: One plain sentence per status (busy, rate limit, server problem, no capacity) without JSON or transport text; Details shows the raw reply for a bug report.

flows.name: see that frog is retrying a model call
steps: Have a model call fail transiently
flows.expected: A notice row says the call is being retried, or that Frog Cloud's stand-in is answering for now.

flows.name: read warnings and info notices
flows.expected: Warnings show as one collapsed system line that expands to the full text; engine diagnostics never reach the transcript.

flows.name: know the engine died mid-turn
flows.expected: A red line says why the engine stopped (killed, missing session, its fatal line) without OS error strings, and the turn stops showing Working….

flows.name: not be stuck on a spinner after the stream dies
steps: Cut the event stream without ending the turn
flows.expected: The conversation reconciles from the session log and stops showing busy once the log says the turn ended.

flows.name: try again after a failed turn
steps: Have a turn end with an error
Send the prompt again or a retry from the composer status line (hand-off: composer agent)
flows.expected: A new turn starts normally after the failed one.

features.name: Interrupting a turn
features.what: Stop the running turn from the menu, Esc or the composer's stop button; the turn ends Interrupted and queued messages behave as stop says.
entry_points: Esc in the composer while busy (hand-off: composer agent)

flows.name: stop a turn that's going the wrong way
steps: While it runs choose Session > Interrupt (⌘.)
flows.expected: The interrupt op goes to the engine, the turn ends with an Interrupted banner, and the conversation is idle.

flows.name: not deny a card by accident when interrupting
flows.expected: Interrupt is disabled while a card is up; ⌘. denies the card instead.

flows.name: have queued messages and wakes survive a stop
steps: Queue a message or let a background wake park
flows.expected: What was parked still flushes into the next turn after the stop.

flows.name: stop one subagent without stopping the turn
flows.expected: The row says Stopping…, the agent stops, and the turn continues with what it found.

features.name: Permission cards
features.what: A step that needs approval shows a card under its row with the command or diff, where it runs, and Deny / Allow (once) / always-allow / deny with a note.
entry_points: … menu: Always allow / Allow prefix, Deny with a note…

flows.name: see what frog wants to do before it does it
steps: Send a task that runs a command
flows.expected: The row turns to a hand icon and a card appears with the question, reason, the command in a well (or a diff preview), and Runs on this Mac · sandboxed / outside the sandbox / in your Frog Cloud sandbox.

flows.name: let one step run
flows.expected: The allow decision goes to the engine, the card goes, the step runs and completes.

flows.name: refuse a step
flows.expected: The deny goes to the engine, the card goes, the step's row says Denied and the turn carries on.

flows.name: refuse a step and say what to do instead
flows.expected: The deny carries the trimmed note to the engine; Deny is disabled while the note is blank.

flows.name: stop being asked for this kind of step
steps: Get a card offering an always choice
Choose the always-allow label (or allow prefix for an approval card)
flows.expected: allow_always (or allow_prefix) goes to the engine and the next matching step runs without a card; requests that are decided every time offer no always choice.

flows.name: find out a card is waiting when Frog isn't in front
flows.expected: The Dock bounces and a notification posts (hand-off: settings agent for notification preferences).
flows.why_hard: Dock bounce and system notifications are outside the app.

flows.name: be asked before a push, reset --hard, rebase, kill or system setting even when sandboxed
steps: Use Ask or Accept Edits mode
flows.expected: A card appears even though the command is sandboxed (0.6.1, #387).
flows.why_hard: The classification is the engine's; needs a real engine and a scripted model.

features.name: Permission modes in effect
features.what: The session's mode (Ask, Accept Edits, Auto, Yolo) decides which steps card, which run with an Auto tag, and which widen access with a quiet row.

flows.name: change the permission mode from the menu
flows.expected: set_mode goes to the engine and the status shows the new mode.

flows.name: approve each risky step in Ask
steps: Send a task that edits a file and runs a command
flows.expected: Both the edit and the command show cards.
flows.why_hard: Which steps card is decided in the engine.

flows.name: let edits through but check commands
steps: Send a task that edits and runs a command
flows.expected: Edits run without a card; the command still cards.
flows.why_hard: Engine decision.

flows.name: see why Auto let a step run
steps: Look at a step that ran without asking
flows.expected: The step carries an Auto: <why> tag with help explaining the classifier let it run.

flows.name: see what Yolo allowed
steps: Confirm Yolo in the composer (hand-off: composer agent)
Let frog reach a new host
flows.expected: A quiet row says the hosts are now allowed for the session; a blocked connection in other modes shows as a warning row.

flows.name: have children never exceed the parent's mode
steps: Run a session in Accept Edits
Let it start a child session
flows.expected: The child inherits a mode capped at the parent's; a Yolo ceiling needs the flag.

features.name: Computer use rows
features.what: With computer use on, desktop tool calls (mcp__desktop__*, Screenshot) show as tool rows with screenshots and a live approximate step preview.
entry_points: Settings toggle Let frog see and use other apps (hand-off: settings agent)

flows.name: watch frog act on another app
steps: Turn on computer use (hand-off: settings agent)
Ask frog to do something in another app
flows.expected: Rows with the window-and-cursor icon show a live image marked Approximate step preview, replaced by the result's screenshots when the step completes.

flows.name: have frog really drive another app
flows.expected: The engine runs with --computer-use and the action happens on the desktop.
flows.why_hard: Takes over the real screen; Mac tests must never take over the user's screen.

features.name: Questions the agent asks
features.what: The model's Ask shows as a card after the last turn: one click answers a single choice; several picks, your own words, or Skip.

flows.name: answer a single-choice question in one click
steps: Let frog ask a single-choice question
flows.expected: The pick goes to the engine as the answer and the card goes.

flows.name: answer with the keyboard
flows.expected: The second option is picked (keys 1-9 work only while not typing in the field).

flows.name: pick several options
steps: Let frog ask a multi-choice question (or click Pick several)
flows.expected: Clicks toggle picks instead of answering; Answer sends all picks; the card is wide whichever way you got there.

flows.name: answer in my own words
flows.expected: The typed words (and any picks) go as the answer; a click while typing picks rather than answers.

flows.name: let frog decide
flows.expected: An empty answer goes to the engine and the card goes.

flows.name: have a card disappear when it's answered elsewhere
steps: Answer it from another client or let it be withdrawn
flows.expected: question_resolved removes the card.

features.name: A quiet or dead child becomes a question
features.what: When a subagent or child session produces nothing for five minutes, the parent asks keep waiting or stop it and carry on; a crashed child is reported at once (0.7.0, #411).
entry_points: The question card on the parent conversation

flows.name: decide what to do about a stalled child
steps: Start a task that launches a subagent or child session
Let the child go quiet for child_quiet_secs
flows.expected: A question names the child, what it was asked and how long it has been quiet, offering keep waiting or stop and carry on.
flows.why_hard: Real watchdog needs the engine with a short child_quiet_secs; the card itself is fake-engine-ok.

flows.name: keep waiting on a slow child
flows.expected: The child keeps running and the parent turn keeps waiting.
flows.why_hard: Engine behaviour after the answer.

flows.name: stop a stalled child and use what it has
steps: Pick stop it and carry on
flows.expected: The child stops and the parent continues with the child's partial result.
flows.why_hard: Engine behaviour after the answer.

flows.name: not be asked once the child speaks again
steps: Let the child emit an event
flows.expected: The question withdraws by itself.

flows.name: know straight away when a child crashed
flows.expected: A dead Task returns an error naming the death; a dead child session's parent gets a note.
flows.why_hard: Needs a real child engine to crash.

features.name: MCP elicitation and sign-in cards
features.what: An MCP server asking for input shows a form card (Submit / Decline / Cancel, or an open-URL step); servers needing sign-in show a card with Sign in.

flows.name: give an MCP tool what it asks for
steps: Call an MCP tool that elicits input
flows.expected: accept with the content goes to the engine and the card goes.

flows.name: refuse or cancel an MCP request
flows.expected: decline or cancel goes to the engine; cancel ends the tool call.

flows.name: complete an MCP step in the browser
steps: Get an elicitation that needs a URL
flows.expected: The URL opens in the browser.
flows.why_hard: Opens the default browser.

flows.name: sign in to an MCP server that dropped its tools
steps: Configure an MCP server that needs sign-in
Click Sign in on the card
flows.expected: The card names the signed-out servers; signing in starts the server's auth (hand-off: settings agent).
flows.why_hard: OAuth against a real server.

features.name: Find in conversation
features.what: A find bar over the pane matches whole turns by prompt or output, steps through them and marks them on the timeline rail.

flows.name: find a turn by its words
flows.expected: The bar shows N of M (or No matches) and scrolls to the first matching turn.

flows.name: move between matches
steps: Search for a word with several matches
flows.expected: Each press scrolls to the next/previous matching turn and the counter follows; the arrows are disabled with no matches.

flows.name: see where matches are in a long conversation
flows.expected: Matching turns are marked beside their ticks while the bar is open.

flows.name: close the find bar
flows.expected: The bar slides away; Find Next/Previous are disabled again.

features.name: Jumping between turns and the timeline rail
features.what: Move turn by turn with the keyboard, or scrub the timeline rail (chapters, a thumb over turns on screen, marks on turns that need you).
entry_points: Hover / click / drag the timeline rail

flows.name: move one turn up or down
steps: Open a conversation with several turns
flows.expected: The transcript scrolls to the turn above or below the top-most visible one and stops following.

flows.name: see a turn's prompt from the rail
steps: Hover a point on the rail
flows.expected: The prompt of the turn under the pointer shows as a label.

flows.name: scrub the conversation
steps: Click a point on the rail
flows.expected: The transcript jumps to the turn under the pointer as you drag.

flows.name: see the conversation's shape as chapters
steps: Have several prompts, a long autonomous run and a compaction
flows.expected: A dot per chapter (solid for prompts, hollow for autonomous runs, a gap at compaction) with names when there's room; model titles replace heuristics.

flows.name: spot failed, stopped or running turns
steps: Have a failed turn and a running one
flows.expected: Only turns that need you are coloured; the thumb covers the turns on screen.

flows.name: jump to a turn from its menu
flows.expected: The transcript scrolls to that turn.
flows.why_hard: Context menu.

features.name: Detail level per session
features.what: Session > Detail overrides the app's default (Quiet, Normal, Verbose) for one session, changing how much thinking and step detail shows.

flows.name: see only the answer and one line of work
flows.expected: Thinking rows disappear and work is one line; only this session changes.

flows.name: see every thought and step open
flows.expected: Thoughts and steps render expanded and a thought streams in full.

flows.name: go back to the app default
flows.expected: The override is cleared; overrides are remembered per session across opens.

features.name: Undo last turn and rewind
features.what: Undo Last Turn (or Rewind to Before This Turn) restores files Frog edited in that turn and later and continues on a new branch session, keeping the old one.
entry_points: Prompt right-click > Rewind to Before This Turn…
Rail right-click > Rewind to Before This Turn…

flows.name: undo what the last turn did to my files
steps: Finish a turn that edited files
flows.expected: Files go back, a new branch session opens with Rewound to before turn N and restored K files, and the old session is kept.

flows.name: know when there's nothing to undo
steps: Open a session whose last turn changed no files, or while busy
Look at the transcript and the sidebar
flows.expected: Undo Last Turn is disabled; the label names the turn when one is undoable.

flows.name: rewind to before any earlier turn
steps: Click Rewind (or right-click > Rewind to Before This Turn…)
flows.expected: Files edited in that turn and later are restored and the conversation continues on a branch from there.

flows.name: back out of a rewind
flows.expected: Nothing changes.

flows.name: know when a rewind failed
steps: Rewind a session the engine can't rewind
Look at the transcript and the sidebar
flows.expected: A warning toast says Rewind failed with the reason.

features.name: Fork
features.what: Branch the session after a turn into a new session and switch to it.
entry_points: Rail right-click > Fork After This Turn

flows.name: try a different direction without losing this one
steps: Choose Session > Fork After Last Turn (⇧⌘D)
flows.expected: A new session starts from that point with the history up to it, and the original stays in the sidebar.

flows.name: branch from an earlier turn
steps: Click Fork (or right-click > Fork from Here)
flows.expected: A new session with history up to that turn opens.

flows.name: find a fork next to where it came from
steps: Look at the sidebar (hand-off: sidebar agent)
flows.expected: The fork folds under its source session.

flows.name: not fork mid-turn
flows.expected: Fork After Last Turn is disabled until the turn finishes.

features.name: Compact conversation
features.what: Compaction summarises the history to free context; a success shows a carried-forward banner with a receipt; a failed one offers a carried-forward session.

flows.name: free up context
steps: Have a conversation with some turns
flows.expected: The conversation is busy while compacting, then a chapter break and the carried forward · everything important was saved banner appear at the top.

flows.name: check what was kept
flows.expected: The receipt lists files with +/−, turns with their requests and outcomes, and tests run with pass/fail.

flows.name: carry on when the context overflowed
steps: Overflow the context so compaction fails
flows.expected: continue_session goes to the engine, a new session opens carried forward, and one honest line replaces the banner.

flows.name: understand a rescue that can't start
steps: Trigger the rescue where no session host is installed
Look at the transcript and the sidebar
flows.expected: The line says the carried-forward session couldn't start, in warning colour.

flows.name: not compact when there's nothing to compact
steps: Open an empty or busy conversation
Look at the transcript and the sidebar
flows.expected: Compact Conversation is disabled.

features.name: Race
features.what: One prompt, several attempts in parallel, each in its own worktree with optional check; view each, apply one, discard the rest.
entry_points: Composer race popover: attempts, models, check, Start N Attempts (hand-off: composer agent)
Race card: View, Apply, Discard All, Close

flows.name: try several models on the same prompt
steps: Pick models and an optional check
flows.expected: A race card shows one line per attempt with its model and progress.
flows.why_hard: Spawns several real engines and git worktrees.

flows.name: know why a race can't start
steps: Open a folder that isn't a git repo
Look at the transcript and the sidebar
flows.expected: An error says racing needs a git repository.

flows.name: inspect an attempt
flows.expected: A sheet shows that attempt's transcript and changes.
flows.why_hard: Needs finished real attempts.

flows.name: compare attempts by their check
steps: Start a race with a check command
flows.expected: Each attempt shows running, passed or failed with the last lines of output on hover.
flows.why_hard: Real check runs in each worktree.

flows.name: keep the best attempt
flows.expected: Its changes land in the project, the other worktrees are removed, Apply is disabled for the rest.
flows.why_hard: Real worktrees and file changes.

flows.name: throw all attempts away
flows.expected: Every attempt stops and its worktree is removed.
flows.why_hard: Real worktrees.

features.name: Subagents in the transcript
features.what: A Task call is a quiet step row with the agent's live status, Stop while it runs, and a sheet with its whole run.

flows.name: watch a subagent work
steps: Send a task that spawns a subagent
flows.expected: The row names the agent and says what it's doing now; the turn's live line counts the agents.

flows.name: see everything a subagent did
steps: Click a subagent row (running or done)
flows.expected: A sheet shows the agent's run as a transcript.

flows.name: see why a subagent failed
flows.expected: The row shows failed and the help gives the failure's first line.

flows.name: approve a subagent's step
steps: Let a subagent hit a permission
flows.expected: The agent shows as blocked/needs you, the card is answered like any other, and the agent carries on.

flows.name: let a background agent keep working
steps: Let frog start a background Task
Watch its sidebar row (hand-off: sidebar agent)
flows.expected: Its steps fold into its own run with no item in the parent turn; it ends and its row goes.

flows.name: see a conversation's agents under its sidebar row
steps: Run a turn with several agents
Look under the session's sidebar row (hand-off: sidebar agent)
flows.expected: Working, waiting and finished agents show as rows; once the turn ends finished ones fold into N done · M failed; a row opens the session.

features.name: Child sessions and messages between sessions
features.what: A session can start other sessions, message them, and hear back; messages from another session open a turn as a card that links to its sender, and a child's approvals reach its parent.
entry_points: Open the session that sent this (link on a message row)
Answering a child's card from the parent

flows.name: have frog start a session for parallel work
steps: Ask frog to start a worker session
flows.expected: The child starts in its own worktree outside the main checkout (based on the remote default branch) and its last reply is reported back to the parent; the sidebar nests it under the parent.

flows.name: see a message from another session
steps: Have another session send this one a message
flows.expected: The turn opens with a collapsed message line naming the sender (not a user bubble); clicking opens the sending session.

flows.name: approve a child's step from its parent
steps: Let a child hit a permission card
Answer from the parent (or the chief)
flows.expected: The pending approval reaches the parent without a turn; only the parent's or chief's answer counts and a session can't answer its own card.

flows.name: stop a busy child and clear its queue
steps: Have the parent stop a busy child with clear_queue
flows.expected: The child is interrupted and nothing queued starts its next turn.

flows.name: message a child whose engine died
steps: Send it a message from the parent
flows.expected: The engine restarts and the message starts a turn; a child killed before its first call gets its prompt again.

flows.name: have a session rename, move, re-mode or archive its children
steps: Run a manager session with workers
Ask it to rename a worker, move it under another parent, change its mode or model, or archive it
Look at the sidebar (hand-off: sidebar agent)
flows.expected: The change applies (a mode or model set while the child is stopped applies at its next start); a move that would cycle is refused and archiving cancels the child's queued messages.

flows.name: not have sessions message each other forever
steps: Let two sessions message each other in a loop
flows.expected: Messaging stops at the rate limit until the user acts; the user's message resets it.

flows.name: see that a child is running degraded
steps: Start a child on a fallback or text-tool-call model
Ask the parent for its status
flows.expected: The degraded state reaches the child's status and its badge.

flows.name: see background work that woke the session
steps: Let a background job or monitor finish
Look at the turn it opened
flows.expected: Event rows (glyph, id, outcome) lead the turn instead of a user bubble; a row expands to its payload and log opens the job's log.

features.name: Resume after quit or crash
features.what: Open sessions are saved; quitting mid-turn asks whether to resume; at launch interrupted turns carry on with a Resumed banner (Stop, Resume automatically, dismiss).
entry_points: Quit (⌘Q) alert: Quit and Resume Running Sessions / Quit and Stop Them / Cancel
Resumed banner: Resume automatically checkbox, Stop, ×

flows.name: quit while a turn is running
flows.expected: An alert says N conversations are still working with Quit and Resume / Quit and Stop / Cancel; Cancel keeps the app open.
flows.why_hard: NSAlert.runModal blocks; needs UI automation or a seam for the alert.

flows.name: pick up running turns next launch
flows.expected: The same windows and panes reopen, the turn carries on, and a Resumed after restart banner shows.
flows.why_hard: Needs a real quit and relaunch of the app.

flows.name: let running turns go on quit
flows.expected: Sessions reopen idle without continuing.
flows.why_hard: Needs a real relaunch.

flows.name: recover after Frog crashed
flows.expected: With no quit recorded it's treated as a crash: interrupted turns continue; a turn you stopped just reopens.
flows.why_hard: Needs killing and relaunching the app.

flows.name: not leave engines running after Frog dies
flows.expected: Each engine notices its parent died and exits.
flows.why_hard: Killing the app process under test; the existing tests use a stand-in parent process.

flows.name: stop a turn that resumed on its own
flows.expected: The turn is interrupted.

flows.name: stop a conversation resuming by itself
flows.expected: That session is opted out and just reopens next time; the × dismisses the banner.

flows.name: carry on after an app update
flows.expected: Turns suspended by the update's drain resume with Resumed after app update; their turn shows Suspended for app update.
flows.why_hard: Real update path.

features.name: Reopening a session
features.what: Opening a session from history shows its newest rows at once, replays the rest, and picks up a turn another process is still running.
entry_points: Click a session in the sidebar (hand-off: sidebar agent)

flows.name: open an old session
flows.expected: Its history lands in one step at the end, with Loading session… only if it's slow; no busy state while replaying.

flows.name: watch a turn that's still running elsewhere
steps: Have another frog process running a turn in a session
Open that session in the Mac app
Wait for the history to sync
flows.expected: Once synced the turn shows as running here too.

flows.name: type before the history is in
flows.expected: The message waits and goes after the history.

flows.name: switch sessions without stopping work
flows.expected: The turn kept running; an idle startup engine was let go.

flows.name: reopen a session on the model and mode it last used
steps: Run a session on model A in Accept Edits
Pick model B for a new chat
flows.expected: The resumed engine gets no model or mode flag, so it keeps A and Accept Edits.

features.name: Worktrees and opening a folder
features.what: A conversation runs in a folder or worktree; a worktree another engine holds shows why with a way to its owner; File > Open Folder… opens a folder window.
entry_points: Open <owner> button on the held-worktree line

flows.name: start working in a project folder
flows.expected: A window opens on that folder (an empty chat switches to it) without a layout crash.
flows.why_hard: NSOpenPanel is modal; the tests drive the state change behind it.

flows.name: open a session whose worktree another engine holds
steps: Run a worker in a worktree
Open another session that resumes in the same worktree
flows.expected: No engine starts and the line names the owning session and when it becomes resumable; a fresh or free worktree still spawns.

flows.name: jump to the session holding a worktree
steps: Open a session refused for a held worktree
Click Open <owner> under the red line
flows.expected: The owning session opens (its window, or here).

flows.name: open a session whose folder is gone
steps: Delete a session's folder on disk
Open that session from the sidebar
flows.expected: A plain message says so instead of hanging.

flows.name: follow frog when it moves to another folder
steps: Wait for the turn to end
flows.expected: The pane reopens the conversation in the new folder, and the sidebar and git bar follow.

flows.name: see frog's worktrees
steps: Open a repo with frog worktrees
Open the composer's place menu (hand-off: composer agent)
flows.expected: frog's own trees and the main checkout list with branch and dirtiness; held trees are disabled.

features.name: Inspector Changes tab
features.what: The inspector's first tab lists every file changed in the session with counts, opens each to its diffs, and offers Commit and Open PR / Push (no per-file discard exists at v0.7.0).

flows.name: open and close the inspector
steps: Press ⌥⌘0 again (or the × in the strip)
flows.expected: The inspector column appears flush on the right with Changes, Terminal and Preview tabs in the title row, then goes away entirely.

flows.name: see that nothing has changed yet
steps: Open a session with no edits
flows.expected: The Changes tab says No changes yet · Files Frog edits show up here, filling the height.

flows.name: see every file the session changed
flows.expected: N files +a −d, then one row per file in first-touched order with name, folder and counts; new files are marked.

flows.name: read a file's diffs
flows.expected: The row opens to each edit's diff (Edit 1 of N when several) and folds; a lone file opens by itself.

flows.name: open every diff at once
flows.expected: All files open, then all close.

flows.name: watch changes arrive during a turn
steps: Let frog edit a new file
flows.expected: The new file appears in the list as its edit completes.

flows.name: commit the session's changes
steps: Open Changes in a repo session
flows.expected: The composer's draft_commit action runs with the tray's prompt and error slot (hand-off: composer agent).

flows.name: open a PR or push
steps: Open Changes in a repo session
Click Open PR (or Push once a PR is bound)
flows.expected: The composer's open_pr / push action runs (hand-off: composer agent); chats show neither button.
flows.why_hard: Real GitHub.

flows.name: make the inspector wider or narrower
flows.expected: Width stays between 360 and 560 and persists; double-click resets to 420.

flows.name: open or reveal a changed file
steps: Choose Open in editor, Reveal in Finder, Quick Look, or Copy Path
flows.expected: The file opens, is revealed, previews or its path is copied.
flows.why_hard: Context menu and system apps.

features.name: Inspector Terminal tab
features.what: A shell the engine runs and the user can type into, shown from engine-sent grids; frog can open it, and a failed command reaches the model.

flows.name: open a shell in the project
flows.expected: Starting shell… then a prompt in the session folder; the header shows the folder.

flows.name: understand why a chat has no terminal
flows.expected: No terminal · A chat has no folder to open a shell in.

flows.name: run my own command in the shared shell
flows.expected: Keys go to the engine as pane input (arrows, ⌥ as Meta, control characters), the grid updates, and the header shows You while you type.

flows.name: copy output and paste a command
steps: Drag to select text in the grid
flows.expected: The selection is copied; paste sends the text to the shell.

flows.name: keep the shell's size right
flows.expected: The new size in cells goes to the engine.

flows.name: see that the shell ended
steps: Type exit (or a failing command that ends the shell)
flows.expected: The header shows exited or exited N in orange, and the last screen stays.

flows.name: see a terminal frog opened
steps: Let frog open a terminal pane
flows.expected: The inspector opens by itself and brings the terminal tab forward.

flows.name: have frog notice a command I ran failed
steps: Run a failing command in the Terminal tab
flows.expected: The model hears about the failure without being told (0.6.0, #371).
flows.why_hard: The engine detects the failure in its shell; needs a real engine.

flows.name: close the terminal
flows.expected: The pane closes and the tab returns to its open-a-terminal state.

flows.name: hide or tab away from a focused terminal
steps: Hide the inspector, narrow the window, or tab away
flows.expected: The app does not hang in the focus walk.

features.name: Inspector Preview tab
features.what: One browser bar (back, forward, reload/stop, address, device size, compare, pick an element, open in browser, pop out) over the live page frog and the user share.

flows.name: open the preview before anything runs
flows.expected: Nothing to preview yet · Run your dev server, then enter its URL or port, or ask Frog to open it, centred in the body.

flows.name: load my dev server
flows.expected: The field selects all on focus; a bare port or host:port becomes an http URL, the page loads with a progress line, and the field shows host and path.

flows.name: navigate the page
steps: Load a page and follow a link
flows.expected: Back and Forward are enabled only when possible; Reload becomes Stop while loading.

flows.name: recover from a page that didn't load
steps: Enter an address with nothing listening
flows.expected: Couldn't load <address> with a one-sentence reason and Retry; Retry loads what failed.

flows.name: see the page at phone, tablet or desktop size
steps: Pick Tablet, then Desktop, then Fit
flows.expected: The page keeps the device's shape, scaled down (never up) to fit the body; Fit fills it.

flows.name: use the tools in a narrow inspector
steps: Make the inspector narrower than 400 pt
flows.expected: One toolbar row at every width; below 400 the tools fold into More with Device size as a section.

flows.name: point frog at an element on the page
flows.expected: A hint says Click an element to mention it · Esc to stop; the click tells the engine and inserts a mention in the composer, with a chip in the bar while it's in the draft (hand-off: composer agent).

flows.name: know why Pick an element is off
steps: Open the preview with no page
flows.expected: It is disabled with Open a page to pick an element on it.

flows.name: leave inspect mode
flows.expected: Inspect mode ends.

flows.name: open the page in my browser
flows.expected: The page opens in the default browser; disabled with no http/file page.
flows.why_hard: Opens an external browser.

flows.name: give the preview its own window
steps: Click Open in its own window
flows.expected: The page moves to a window with the same toolbar while the tab says In its own window; closing it brings the page back.
flows.why_hard: Separate window scene.

flows.name: compare the page with how it was before a turn
steps: Load a page across several turns
Click Compare with an earlier turn
flows.expected: It opens on the newest screenshot up to the current turn; Then shows the checkpoint and Now the live page; with none it says No screenshots yet.

flows.name: compare from the timeline
steps: Right-click a camera-badged turn on the rail
flows.expected: The inspector opens on the preview comparing against that turn.
flows.why_hard: Context menu.

flows.name: watch frog open, read and click the page
steps: Ask frog to open and check the app
flows.expected: The inspector brings the preview forward, frog's navigation loads, and its read/click/type/screenshot requests are answered; console output and errors are reported back.
